question.prompt: For the data 1 through 8, find the first and third quartiles using the method of taking the median of each half of the data. (The data are 1, 2, …, 8. Write the first quartile followed by the third quartile, separated by a comma.)

solutions.explanation: The median of the lower half, 1, 2, 3, 4, is 2.5. The median of the upper half, 5, 6, 7, 8, is 6.5.
solutions.title: Medians of the two halves
